title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus attention gating, a more flexible, theoretically motivated gate. Our 36B-A4B model uses both and nearly matches a 32B dense model trained on the same data, with one-seventh the active parameters. We also introduce Uno, lossless diffusion adapters that speed up decoding by up to 2.2x without a separate draft model. translated_title: K2-Horizon：开源语言模型的前沿舰队
translated_abstract: 我们提出了K2-Horizon，这是一支由六个完全开源的语言模型组成的舰队，涵盖从0.9B的稠密模型到375B-A23B的MoE模型，专为通用推理和智能体工作而构建，应用于数学与科学、软件工程、深度研究、办公自动化等领域。这些模型在智能体和编程基准测试中领先于或可与同规模的其他强开源模型相竞争。在建模方面，为增强推理能力，我们引入了价值混合注意力，将MoE应用于注意力的价值投影，并提出了softplus注意力门控——一种更灵活、具有理论依据的门控机制。我们的36B-A4B模型同时采用了这两项技术，在激活参数仅为七分之一的情况下，几乎追平了在相同数据上训练的32B稠密模型。我们还引入了Uno，一种无损扩散适配器，无需单独的草稿模型即可将解码速度提升至多2.2倍。本次发布遵循LLM360对开源的定义，以保证透明性和可复现性：完整的开发过程……
tldr: K2-Horizon发布了六款完全开源的语言模型舰队（从0.9B稠密模型到375B-A23B MoE），通过价值混合注意力、softplus注意力门控和Uno无损扩散适配器等创新技术，在智能体与编程基准上以更少的激活参数达到同规模领先性能。
en_tdlr: K2-Horizon presents a fleet of six fully open-source language models, introducing Mixture-of-Value Attention, softplus attention gating, and Uno lossless diffusion adapters to achieve leading agentic and coding performance with significantly fewer active parameters.
